definitions.meaning: A day on which high mass is celebrated

quotations.old_english: An heáhmæssedagum, þ-bar; is Sancte Stephanes and Sancte Ióhannes . . .

source_text: heáhmæsse-dæg, es; m. A day on which high mass is celebrated :-- An heáhmæssedagum, þ-bar; is Sancte Stephanes and Sancte Ióhannes . . ., Nap. 36.
